races.name: Coral Rewards Shaker Handicap Stakes (Gbbplus Race)

runners_data.name: Tierra Del Toro
runners_data.note: Ralph Beckett's three-year-old has course form at Goodwood and leads here unchallenged, but its recent form string (212-39) includes a tired ninth on this card last year and its style-fit tag suggests it may not always command the front with authority; James Doyle will seek to exploit a soft lead but it is worth noting the OR of 97 is the highest in the field.

runners_data.name: Cannes
runners_data.note: Dylan Browne McMonagle partners a horse with a Goodwood 12f win to its name and a consistent placed record in similar conditions; Joseph O'Brien's yard has been firing at 19/68 over 14 days and Cannes's prominent style suits the anticipated race shape perfectly, making it one of the chief dangers to the leader.

runners_data.name: Infraad
runners_data.note: William Haggas's lightly-raced three-year-old has three Goodwood runs over 10f with a win and two thirds, giving strong course confidence; Tom Marquand's booking is significant and the step up to 12f looks well within range given its staying pedigree, representing excellent placement from a shrewd stable.

runners_data.name: Bay Royale
runners_data.note: Harry Eustace's gelding arrives on a 71-day absence wearing headgear and brings a 10f Goodwood win and a soft-ground second to the table; the headgear is a notable variable and the layoff demands scrutiny, but Pierre-Louis Jamin is an able partner and the horse is lightly raced enough to have more improvement in the locker.

runners_data.name: Hatteen
runners_data.note: Oisin Murphy takes the ride on Andrew Balding's hold-up specialist who won over 12f at Goodwood last time out and has placed repeatedly at course and distance; a 20-day turnaround is straightforward and the concern is whether a lone, uncontested pace-setter will generate enough gallop to allow a true hold-up horse to deliver its challenge.

runners_data.name: Baltic Fleet
runners_data.note: Ian Williams's three-year-old is a genuine front-running/prominent type at heart, though with so many horses contesting the forward positions it is likely to end up racing off the pace in a role that does not suit — William Buick's skill may limit the damage but its 61-day absence and out-of-role positioning temper expectations.

runners_data.name: Blue Hercules
runners_data.note: Billy Loughnane rides for the Muir & Grassick yard, which has produced just 1 winner from 13 runners over 14 days; Blue Hercules has multiple course runs on Good ground with two seconds from five attempts at Goodwood, but a form string of 84202 does not inspire and the hold-up style needs more pace than this race is likely to generate.

runners_data.name: Parisian Scholar
runners_data.note: Charlie Johnston's hold-up specialist has won twice over 12f at Goodwood and arrives in form after consecutive victories; however, Rowan Scott is a less high-profile booking at this level and the horse's tendency to race from the rear means it needs a genuine gallop — its back-to-back wins are the compelling form angle to respect.

runners_data.name: Sea And Sun
runners_data.note: The second Johnston runner ridden by Silvestre De Sousa, with a style marked as unknown and only three career runs to assess; its 12f Goodwood fourth last time and consistent placed form in soft conditions offer some encouragement, but the step to Good ground and a small sample size make it the most speculative runner in the field.

races.paceDynamic: Tierra Del Toro is the lone confirmed front-runner and, with no serious challenger for the lead, James Doyle can dictate a controlled, sustainable gallop from the front over this 1m4f trip at Goodwood on Good ground. Behind the leader, Cannes, Infraad, and Bay Royale are all prominent types who will compete for the positions immediately off the pace, creating a busy but not frantic early order through the field. The hold-up brigade — Hatteen, Blue Hercules, and Parisian Scholar — will settle at the rear, needing the pace to pick up in the straight to deliver their challenge. This race shape, with a single uncontested leader setting a measured tempo, strongly favours prominent racers and those who can travel just behind the leader and pounce in the straight, rather than deep closers who require a genuinely strong gallop to get into it. Baltic Fleet is a genuine prominent type but, with so many runners already contesting those forward positions, it is most likely to be pushed further back than its natural style demands, reducing its ability to land a telling blow.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tierra Del Toro Controls Unchallenged
scenarios.trigger: If Tierra Del Toro leads at a measured pace and the prominent pack behind fail to unsettle the tempo, allowing a controlled run from the front.
scenarios.body: Tierra Del Toro, ridden by James Doyle under Ralph Beckett's astute handling, dictates every fraction and uses Goodwood's straight to quicken away before challengers can organise; the sustainable gallop means horses who travel prominently just behind the leader are ideally placed to pick off any tiring front-runner. Cannes and Infraad, both comfortable in prominent spots and proven at this course and distance, are best placed to pounce if the leader comes back to them late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Racer Stalks And Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If Tierra Del Toro's controlled pace suits a prominent stalker who travels smoothly and kicks clear in the Goodwood straight.
scenarios.body: One of the prominent trio immediately behind the leader — most likely Cannes or Infraad — tracks the tempo comfortably, produces a smooth challenge inside the final two furlongs and gets on top before the hold-up horses arrive. Infraad's course and distance form at Goodwood is strong and Cannes's win over 12f here last time makes both dangerous in this shape.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Lands From Hold-Up
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is strong enough through the middle stages to stretch the field and allow a hold-up horse to arrive with a sustained late run.
scenarios.body: Hatteen, who has finished placed over course and distance, or Parisian Scholar, a dual course-and-distance winner, would need the early pace to be genuine enough to set up a closing run; on Good ground with a single front-runner going easy, this scenario is less probable but not impossible if the prominent group push Tierra Del Toro along. Of the true hold-up types, Hatteen's recent 1 over 12f at Goodwood and Oisin Murphy's big-race awareness make it the most capable beneficiary.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Slow Pace Bunches The Field
scenarios.trigger: If the tempo is so dawdling that the race becomes a sprint from two furlongs out, nullifying any running-style advantage.
scenarios.body: A truly muddling gallop compresses the field and turns the finish into a short-distance test of raw speed, which could benefit horses who handle a messy tactical race; Bay Royale, with headgear on and unexposed at the trip, could thrive in a sprint finish after a slow-run race. Sea And Sun, despite the UNKNOWN style flag, has run respectably in recent races and would not be without a chance if the race is reduced to a dash home.

watchPoints.text: Tierra Del Toro sets the entire pace dynamic — watch whether James Doyle elects to bowl along or dawdle, as either extreme will dramatically shift which horses are advantaged in the straight.

Baltic Fleet is a true prominent type that may struggle to find its natural position behind the leader given competition from Cannes, Infraad, and Bay Royale for the early spots; if it fails to slot in, William Buick may find it racing in an unfamiliar and disadvantageous role.

Bay Royale returns after 71 days wearing headgear — first-time or resumed headgear combined with a lengthy absence can produce unpredictable behaviour, and it is worth monitoring in the preliminaries and early strides.

Parisian Scholar's back-to-back wins over course and distance make it potentially the most underestimated runner in the field if the pace is stronger than anticipated; watch where Rowan Scott positions it in the early stages as a clue to how confident the yard is.

Hatteen won over 12f at Goodwood last time and Oisin Murphy rarely rides without intent — if Murphy positions it closer than usual given the likely steady gallop, it is a signal that the Balding team expects the pace to be insufficient for a hold-up ride.

races.name: British Stallion Studs Ebf Alice Keppel Fillies' Conditions Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Call Nicki
runners_data.note: Six runs at Goodwood with two wins and three places on this track, Tim Easterby's filly arrives on a 13-day turnaround in peak condition and will be first to the front; suited by an honest pace she sets herself, though a rival pressing her throughout is the one genuine complication.

runners_data.name: Divine Whisper
runners_data.note: George Boughey's filly has won and placed at this track and trip, and Billy Loughnane rides with intent, but her natural prominent running style has been redistributed toward the rear of the map because the field is stacked with pace; she should be considered with that style discount in mind.

runners_data.name: Envision
runners_data.note: James Owen's runner won a 5f Goodwood maiden last time and carries a tongue-tie, but with more prominent types in this field than positions available, she is likely to find herself a length or two further back than her natural game demands — that compromise tempers her odds in a contested scenario.

runners_data.name: Fast Track
runners_data.note: Andrew Balding's colt (tongue-tied) holds the top OR in the lead group at 86, won his latest start over course and distance with Oisin Murphy aboard, and will press Call Nicki throughout; the key question is whether that duel costs him the finish.

runners_data.name: Hidden Gift
runners_data.note: Richard and Peter Fahey's filly holds the headline OR of 120, a significant class edge on paper, but has only placed once in two starts and steps back to 5f after a 6f debut; how Oisin Orr slots her into the prominent pack scramble early will determine everything.

runners_data.name: Miss Lizzy
runners_data.note: Charlie Fellowes' filly won over 6f at Sandown and has Good-going form, but her last two Goodwood runs were modest (11th, 3rd) and Paddy Bradley inherits a horse who needs a clean passage through the mid-pack traffic to show her best.

runners_data.name: Princesse d'Orange
runners_data.note: Ryan Moore takes over for David O'Meara's filly, who won on soft going and has not shown the same effectiveness on Good; three of her four runs are on Goodwood turf but she has finished 3rd, 5th, and 17th here — this represents a difficult assignment even with the upgrade in jockey.

runners_data.name: Wild Blossom
runners_data.note: K.R. Burke's lightly raced filly won impressively on course and going last time with James Doyle, carries an unknown style tag suggesting tactical flexibility, but two runs is a thin evidence base and the 42-day layoff adds a small question mark despite the strong form platform.

runners_data.name: Zigazig Ah
runners_data.note: Richard Spencer's filly arrives on an 11-day turnaround having won her last two starts including a 6f Goodwood success; Saffie Osborne keeps the ride and her two Goodwood wins suggest she handles the track well — strong claims if she secures a prominent berth before the scrimmage develops.

races.paceDynamic: Call Nicki and Fast Track are the two confirmed front-runners and will immediately contest the lead from the gates, creating a genuinely contested pace on Goodwood's sharp five furlongs. Four of the nine runners want prominent positions, meaning Zigazig Ah, Miss Lizzy, Princesse d'Orange, and Hidden Gift will be jostling for space in the first two furlongs, generating traffic compression around the 2f-3f mark. The honest, pressed gallop set by two genuine speed horses will stretch the field early and leave little room for late momentum to build from behind. This race shape strongly favours horses who can race prominently without burning energy fighting for position — pure front-end speed and horses who can sit a close second or third without a fight will be best placed. The field holds more front-running and prominent types than positions allow: Call Nicki and Fast Track are most likely to actually lead, with Zigazig Ah and Miss Lizzy the most credible to secure prominent berths ahead of the shuffled-back redistribution runners.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Contested Lead Holds Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Call Nicki or Fast Track clears the prominent scramble and sets a true pace that stretches rivals, rewarding front-end stamina.
scenarios.body: The two leaders push each other along at an honest gallop, the mid-pack congestion prevents closers from building a clear run, and the race is won from the front or close to it. Horses who can handle being pressed throughout Goodwood's run-in without folding are the primary beneficiaries.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Stalker Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders press each other into modest error and a prominent tracker arrives with a clean run at the furlong pole.
scenarios.body: The contested lead tightens marginally in the final furlong, allowing the best-placed stalker to come from a length or two adrift and collar a tiring leader. A horse with a clean prep and a high strike rate on this course and going is ideally positioned for this shape.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Pair Combust Early
scenarios.trigger: If Call Nicki and Fast Track burn each other out inside two furlongs and leave the door open for a fresh-legged runner to pick up the pieces.
scenarios.body: Both leaders fade sharply in the final furlong having emptied their tanks in the duel, and a horse sitting just off the pace in fifth or sixth capitalises on their collapse. Wild Blossom, lightly raced and with a big winning run in the book on this track and going, is the type to benefit from a pace collapse without having burned her reserves.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Surge From Rear
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is fierce enough to create a gap that allows a deep hold-up horse to weave through late traffic and close from last to first.
scenarios.body: Traffic congestion in the midfield shuffles runners wide on the home turn, creating a rare pocket for a horse coming from off the bridle to thread through and finish with purpose. This shape is the least likely given the field's genuine lack of true hold-up types — the horses nominally mapped there are natural front-end runners displaced by the redistribution and are unlikely to produce a genuine late rattle.

watchPoints.text: Call Nicki and Fast Track — monitor which of the two gets the rail and whether either checks or clips heels in the opening furlong when the prominent pack compresses behind them.
Zigazig Ah — arrives on the back of two wins and an 11-day turnaround; if she is caught wide or shuffled back in the prominent scramble, her chance is materially reduced despite strong form claims.
Hidden Gift — the OR-120 class edge is striking but she has run just twice, and if the congestion around the 3f mark catches her in a pocket, her market expectation will not be met.

Wild Blossom — lightly raced and 42 days since last run; watch the paddock closely and note James Doyle's positioning in the first furlong — if she travels kindly and finds clear air, her ceiling is high.

Divine Whisper and Envision — both are natural prominent horses mapped back by redistribution; if either manages to break smartly and reclaim a front-rank position at the start, reassess their chances upward immediately.

races.name: Rolls-royce Oak Tree Stakes (Group 3)

runners_data.name: Flora Of Bermuda
runners_data.note: The confirmed pace-setter with two Goodwood wins over 6f and Good-going course form (9/15 on similar ground); steps up to 7f here which is an open question, and her STYLE_FIT tag signals she is slightly out of her preferred role — she will lead but whether she sees it out is the key query for James Doyle.|

runners_data.name: Royal Velvet
runners_data.note: Five wins and six places from 14 starts on similar Good going (14/15) is an outstanding statistic; Goodwood 7f form reads 5-1-1 which is strong course form, William Buick is a top booking, and at OR 101 she looks very much in her element here racing prominently over her best trip.|

runners_data.name: Brazilian Rose
runners_data.note: A genuine hold-up horse whose recent Goodwood form reads 9-6-5, suggesting she struggles to land a blow around this track specifically; headgear (h) worn and only 3 out of 15 runs on similar going adds concern — Kaiya Fraser faces a stiff ask to make an impact from the rear.|

runners_data.name: Dash Of Azure
runners_data.note: Two recent second-place finishes over Goodwood's 7f at OR 101 show this is her track and trip; Ralph Beckett's stable is 8/41 in the last 14 days and Hector Crouch can position her just off the lead — consistency is her best calling card even if a clear win has not arrived yet.|

runners_data.name: Havana Pusey
runners_data.note: A genuine hold-up type with three wins and six places from 12 Goodwood 7f runs (including a win here) — she is the most course-proven hold-up runner in the field; headgear (ht) is worn, the stable is cold (0/9 last 14 days), but her Goodwood specialist status over this exact trip keeps her relevant.|

runners_data.name: Queen's Reign
runners_data.note: Has not run for 97 days which is the longest absence in the field and a significant fitness query; hold-up style needs a stronger pace than Flora Of Bermuda is likely to set, and her best form on Good going only reads 6/15 — the layoff and pace shape both work against her.|

runners_data.name: Radiant Beauty
runners_data.note: A natural prominent racer who has won three of her last five starts over 8f on Good at Goodwood — note the distance is shorter here at 7f; the redistribution means she may find herself behind horses who naturally settle better, and STYLE_FIT=0.92 tempers expectations.|

runners_data.name: Sayidah Dariyan
runners_data.note: Ryan Moore's booking on the OR 107 top-rated 4yo is the most significant jockey angle in the race; she has been racing over 6f and comes back to 7f where she can hopefully settle and produce a more sustained effort — four places from eight on Good ground is solid if unspectacular.|

runners_data.name: Awaken
runners_data.note: Won over 6f on Good ground, has a 1W3P record across similar conditions, and George Boughey is 4/20 in the last 14 days; she is naturally a prominent-type forced into a midfield slot by the overcrowded front, so Billy Loughnane may find position harder to achieve than ideal, with STYLE_FIT=0.93 reflecting this.|

runners_data.name: Golden Palace
runners_data.note: A 3yo from Richard & Fahey who, though naturally wanting to race up with the pace, cannot realistically secure that berth in this particular field; recent form reading 65-738 is not Group 3 standard, the stable is a very cold 2/39 last 14 days, and the redistribution further constrains her likely impact.|

runners_data.name: Isle Of Fernandez
runners_data.note: Kevin Ryan's 3yo has only 2 runs from 8 on similar Good ground and his best form came on Soft — the going switch to Good here is a potential concern; the 80-day absence and a trainer strike rate of 0/21 over 14 days dampen confidence, even if her course form over 7f is acceptable.|

runners_data.name: Orion's Belt
runners_data.note: Returning from a 305-day absence makes her the biggest fitness unknown in the field by a distance; she is a natural prominent racer who won over Goodwood 7f on Good ground and Pat Dobbs is a fair booking, but 10 months off means this run is almost certainly needed — the redistribution is secondary to that layoff concern.|

runners_data.name: Planet Seeker
runners_data.note: Won twice and placed twice in only four career starts which is a smart record; she is a 3yo who has won over Goodwood 7f on Good, so the course-and-distance form is there — though as a natural prominent runner mapped to midfield, Jamie Spencer may need to be enterprising to get the position that suits her best.|

runners_data.name: Zanthos
runners_data.note: Oisin Murphy on the OR 109 Crisford 3yo is a compelling combination; won over Goodwood 7f on Good ground and placed over the same trip, giving him the best course-and-distance credentials among the 3yos — headgear (t) worn, and his last run (9th over 6f) needs ignoring given the step back to 7f where his best form sits.|

races.paceDynamic: Flora Of Bermuda is the one confirmed front-runner and, operating over 7f at Goodwood on Good ground where she has won twice at 6f, she is expected to bowl along at a controlled, sustainable gallop rather than set a frenetic pace — she will not be pressured into burning herself out. The field is unusually loaded with prominent-racer types: Sayidah Dariyan, Royal Velvet, Dash Of Azure, Isle Of Fernandez and Zanthos all want to race close to the pace and will vie for early position behind her, meaning a compact, organised peloton is likely to form rather than a ragged spread. The redistribution of Awaken, Golden Palace, Orion's Belt, Planet Seeker and Radiant Beauty into the midfield map is a consequence of overcrowding at the front — none are natural hold-up horses, and in a race with this many prominent types, several will simply not secure the position they want. The sustainable, single-pace tempo that Flora Of Bermuda creates over 7f on this flat track strongly favours horses who can travel smoothly just off the pace and unleash a quick late burst — premium hold-up finishers and relaxed prominent racers with a change of gear are best placed, while true hold-up horses who depend on a genuine scorching tempo to make up ground start at a tactical disadvantage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace, Late Burst
scenarios.trigger: If Flora Of Bermuda dictates a sustainable, uncontested tempo that sets up a strong final 2f for the closers off the pace.
scenarios.body: Flora Of Bermuda bowls along in front without being hassled, producing a steady rhythm that leaves plenty in the tank for those tracking behind; horses who travel smoothly and can quicken in the final 2f on Good ground at Goodwood will be rewarded.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Racer Drives Through
scenarios.trigger: If the pace-pressed group creates enough early momentum that a horse travelling prominently just behind the leader sustains all the way to the line.
scenarios.body: With multiple prominent types crowding the early positions, the race develops into one where a well-rated horse sitting second or third on the rail can control their own destiny and grind out victory without needing a late burst; Sayidah Dariyan with Ryan Moore and Dash Of Azure's course form make them the most dangerous under this shape.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Storms Late
scenarios.trigger: If the redistributed midfield runners settle better than expected and the early pace proves faster than anticipated, creating a genuine closer's finish.
scenarios.body: Those genuine hold-up types — Havana Pusey and Queen's Reign — have both the distance profile and course experience at Goodwood 7f to profit if the field strings out and the front-runners tire from crowding; however, the single front-runner tempo makes this genuinely less likely than a fast-pace scenario would require.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wins Outright
scenarios.trigger: If Flora Of Bermuda's Goodwood course form and uncontested lead allows her to steal a march that the field cannot claw back over 7f.
scenarios.body: Flora Of Bermuda has won twice at Goodwood over 6f and with no genuine pace pressure she could conserve enough energy to extend to 7f and hold on; this remains a short-price scenario given she is stepping up in trip and her STYLE_FIT flag suggests she is not in her most natural role here.

watchPoints.text: Royal Velvet's Going record of 14/15 on similar Good ground is exceptional — watch for William Buick to press up early and grab an advantageous rail position behind Flora Of Bermuda, which would make her very hard to pass.|

Zanthos and Oisin Murphy: the highest-OR 3yo in the field has already won over Goodwood 7f on Good ground and if he travels smoothly just off the leader, his finishing speed on this flat track could prove decisive in the final 2f.|

The early jostling for prominent positions between Sayidah Dariyan, Dash Of Azure, Royal Velvet, Isle Of Fernandez and Zanthos could create unexpected crowding even if Flora Of Bermuda sets a modest tempo — watch for potential traffic issues rounding into the straight.|

Orion's Belt returning from 305 days off is a significant market mover to monitor — if support comes for Pat Dobbs's mount, it suggests the Hannon yard have her ready; if she drifts, treat accordingly and do not be drawn in by her course-and-distance form alone.|

Havana Pusey's headgear combination (hood and tongue-tie) and her outstanding Goodwood 7f course record make her the best-value dark horse if the pace quickens unexpectedly — watch how she breaks and whether Clifford Lee can get her into a more forward position than her mapped style suggests.|

races.name: Veuve Clicquot Molecomb Stakes (Group 3)

runners_data.name: Adonius
runners_data.note: Unbeaten in three starts including twice at Goodwood, his course form is outstanding and Rebecca Menzies sends him here in fine nick; a natural prominent racer who should find a clean berth just off the pace and is well-suited to this race shape.

runners_data.name: Bill The Bull
runners_data.note: Recent Goodwood runs have been disappointing (8th and 12th), and despite being a genuine pace-seeking type he is likely to find himself further back than ideal as faster rivals claim the prominent slots ahead of him.

runners_data.name: El Floridita
runners_data.note: Won here over course and distance last time and has Goodwood form figures of 2-1; Rowan Scott should get him into a prominent position naturally and he arrives fresh enough on 39 days off to peak here.

runners_data.name: Flight Signal
runners_data.note: Won on Good at Goodwood last time but the Archie Watson runner is a natural front-end type who will struggle to recreate that position with Hell Of A Spin and others ahead; effectiveness may be blunted by racing in an unnatural slot.

runners_data.name: Hell Of A Spin
runners_data.note: The only confirmed pace-setter and key architect of this race; Adrian Keatley's juvenile has every chance to bowl along uncontested at a fair gallop and his recent form (1-2) suggests he is in form heading into this Group 3.

runners_data.name: Ruler's Pride
runners_data.note: Karl Burke's gelding is the field's sole genuine hold-up horse and James Doyle will look to produce him late; last won over 5f at Goodwood on his debut and needs the prominent pack to tire, which is not guaranteed on this pace map.

runners_data.name: Sale Shark
runners_data.note: Won a 5f Goodwood maiden but has run 5th twice at 6f since, and although Hugo Palmer's colt is a front-end racer by inclination he looks likely to be squeezed into a midfield role where his natural speed cannot express itself fully.

runners_data.name: Undercover Affair
runners_data.note: David Evans's busy juvenile has course-winning form over 5f and has placed consistently; mapped toward hold-up because the prominent ranks are overcrowded, but her natural style is more pressing than closing, so she may fare better than her drawn position suggests.

runners_data.name: Brazilian Diva
runners_data.note: Won at Goodwood on her second start and returns here with legitimate credentials, but Diego Lima will find this a much deeper Group 3 field; pushed into a tighter midfield slot than she wants, her chances depend on finding clear air in the straight.

runners_data.name: Crownbreaker
runners_data.note: Kevin Philippart De Foy's well-related colt has progressed steadily (3-2-5-1) and carries lower weight; David Egan is well worth following here and he can sit close to the pace naturally without being forced out of his role, making him a strong profile fit.

runners_data.name: Pershaada
runners_data.note: Richard Hannon's filly has placed twice in Group company and Sean Levey's booking adds confidence; her form figures at Goodwood itself are modest but she stays well for the trip and can travel prominently if granted a clean run from her draw.

races.paceDynamic: Hell Of A Spin is the sole confirmed front-runner and, with no genuine rival pressing for the lead, is expected to bowl along at a sustainable, uncontested gallop from the gates on Goodwood's five-furlong chute. The cluster of true prominent types — Flight Signal, Brazilian Diva, Sale Shark, Bill The Bull and Undercover Affair — cannot all secure their natural position behind the leader, meaning several will be shuffled into a tighter, more compressed midfield than they would choose, creating a slightly muddled middle section rather than a clean, strung-out pace. El Floridita, Adonius and Crownbreaker are the prominent horses most likely to actually slot into the first three or four positions behind Hell Of A Spin, given their recent course form and the space available. This race shape — a lone, honest but unspectacular front-runner setting a fair clip on Good ground — strongly favours prominent racers who can travel close to the pace throughout and pounce in the final furlong, rather than hold-up horses who will find limited daylight in a compressed field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Holds Lead
scenarios.trigger: If Hell Of A Spin sets an honest but manageable pace and the prominent types immediately behind track it cleanly without interference.
scenarios.body: Hell Of A Spin dictates from the front at a fair clip, with El Floridita, Adonius and Crownbreaker tracking comfortably before a straight duel develops; the horse with the best finishing kick from a close-up position wins.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Swamps Leader
scenarios.trigger: If the compressed midfield breaks forward in the straight, engulfing Hell Of A Spin and turning the finish into a blanket charge.
scenarios.body: The congestion created by so many prominent types mapped into a tight pack means several surge simultaneously at the two-furlong pole, overwhelming the leader as a group; horses with the highest ORs who can thread through traffic benefit most.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Poaches Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses or the midfield bunches so badly that a gap opens wide on the outside in the final furlong.
scenarios.body: Ruler's Pride, the only genuine hold-up type in the field, would need a fortuitous split through a tiring pack and a strong James Doyle drive to reel in the leaders from off the pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses, Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Hell Of A Spin goes too fast early and dies, creating an all-the-way scramble with no one able to quicken cleanly.
scenarios.body: The early leader fades badly entering the final two furlongs, spreading confusion through a tightly grouped field; a horse with tactical versatility who can find a clear run through the resulting gaps picks up the pieces.

watchPoints.text: Hell Of A Spin must be tracked from the break — if she is headed or hassled early, the entire race shape changes and no scenario plays out as modelled.

Flight Signal, Sale Shark and Brazilian Diva are all natural front-end types who cannot all get their position; watch for bumping or interference in the first furlong as they contest the prominent slots behind the leader.

Ruler's Pride is the only true hold-up runner and James Doyle will need daylight in the straight — if the field stays bunched into the final furlong, his chance is materially compromised regardless of ability.
El Floridita's course-and-distance form (2-1 at Goodwood) is the standout piece of track-specific evidence and warrants close attention if he settles prominently as expected in the early exchanges.

Crownbreaker carries 3lb less than the British-trained main rivals and has shown a progressive profile; his lightweight profile combined with Egan's tactical awareness makes him one to monitor if the race develops into a late sprint from a close-up position.

races.name: Visit Qatar Sussex Stakes (Group 1)

runners_data.name: Docklands
runners_data.note: Genuine hold-up horse who finished third in this race last year from off the pace at Goodwood; 18 days since last run is fine, and his sim-going record of 13/15 on Good turf here is strong, but he needs a stronger gallop than Bow Echo is likely to set.

runners_data.name: Lake Forest

runners_data.name: Never So Brave

runners_data.name: Opera Ballo

runners_data.name: Qirat

runners_data.name: Dorset

runners_data.name: Puerto Rico

runners_data.name: Zavateri

races.paceDynamic: Bow Echo is the confirmed front-runner and, with a perfect 5-from-5 record all over this Goodwood mile, will stride to the front from the off and set a controlled, sustainable gallop on Good ground — there is no rival likely to press him hard enough to force a true test of stamina. Behind him, Opera Ballo, Lake Forest, and Gstaad will contest the prominent berths closest to the leader, giving the race a compact, professional quality early. The field holds significantly more prominent types than the race shape can accommodate: Puerto Rico, Never So Brave, Ten Bob Tony, Qirat, and Dorset are all natural front-runners or prominent racers who will be squeezed into a midfield role they are not accustomed to, making their form harder to reproduce. With a single, unchallenged front-runner dictating a measured tempo on a flat mile, the race shape strongly favours confirmed prominent racers who can travel smoothly just behind Bow Echo and produce their effort early in the straight, rather than true hold-up types who need a stronger gallop to generate momentum.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Bow Echo Dictates Unchallenged
scenarios.trigger: If Bow Echo leads without serious pressure and the pace stays controlled to the home turn, allowing him to quicken from the front.
scenarios.body: Bow Echo's unbeaten record at this exact track and trip, combined with a completely clean pace scenario, lets him roll into the straight full of running and stretch clear before rivals can respond; his 5W5P Goodwood mile record on identical Good ground is the standout data point in this field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Racer Wears Him Down
scenarios.trigger: If the controlled pace suits a well-positioned rival who can track Bow Echo and find more in the closing stages when the leader ties up.
scenarios.body: Opera Ballo and Gstaad are the two horses with the class and Goodwood course form to sit a length or two off the pace and produce a sustained challenge once the field straightens; Opera Ballo's OR=125 and 5W7P record at the trip make him the standout beneficiary if Bow Echo's finishing kick is blunted.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops Late
scenarios.trigger: If the gallop is genuinely moderate and the field bunches, creating a delayed sprint finish that allows a closer to pick through beaten rivals.
scenarios.body: Docklands and Seagulls Eleven are the true hold-up horses here and would benefit most if the race compresses in the final two furlongs, with Seagulls Eleven's recent winning form at the trip and course offering some relevance; however, a controlled Bow Echo tempo is unlikely to produce the slow-enough pace that would fully set this up.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Redistributed Prominent Fires
scenarios.trigger: If a front-runner squeezed into midfield — Puerto Rico, Never So Brave, or Ten Bob Tony — manages to recover a better position than expected and gets competitive.
scenarios.body: These horses are racing out of their natural prominent role due to the crowded pace map, so their chance depends on finding a run from an uncharacteristic position; the style-fit discounts are real, but Puerto Rico's Group-level form and Soumillon's tactical intelligence give this the best claim among the redistributed runners.

watchPoints.text: Bow Echo's sectionals from the front are the single biggest shape-setter — if Billy Loughnane opens up a clear lead in the first two furlongs without being pressed, the race is likely to be settled before the turn.

Opera Ballo is 43 days since his last run and, while his Goodwood mile record is outstanding, Appleby runners off a break at Goodwood this season (T14:6/16) should be monitored in the market for confidence signals.

The five redistributed prominent types — Puerto Rico, Never So Brave, Ten Bob Tony, Qirat, and Dorset — will all be jostling for a position they cannot all occupy early on; crowding and traffic issues in the first two furlongs are a genuine risk for riders on those horses.

Zavateri's 102-day absence is the longest layoff in the field and Eve Johnson Houghton's 14-day strike rate (3/29) is modest; watch whether the market takes a strong view on his fitness before post time.

Lake Forest is listed as 1 day since last run which may indicate a same-day or very quick re-entry — connections and declared fitness should be confirmed, as Haggas horses are rarely run back quickly at this level without a clear plan.

races.paceDynamic: Sir Garfield is the lone confirmed front-runner and will attempt to dictate from the outset, but with 28 runners and a field loaded with prominent-style horses — Expert Agent, Lipsink, Under The Twilight, Supreme King, Cashbox, Born Slippy, Velvet Rhythm, Calling A Star, and Lunar Melody all want to race handy — the early portions of this 6f Goodwood handicap will be far from a solo procession. The field holds considerably more front-running and prominent types than the track can physically accommodate at the head of affairs; the horses most likely to actually secure prominent positions are Expert Agent, Supreme King, Under The Twilight, and Velvet Rhythm based on course form, jockey intent, and style purity, while redistributed types such as Kanishka, Riley Rocks, French Affair, Sargent Dennis, and Charlie Mason will be unable to claim their natural berth and will be pushed wider or further back than ideal. On Good ground at Goodwood over 6f, a sustainable but genuinely-run pace set by Sir Garfield and pressed by several handy types will stretch the field out and compress finishing positions — the furlong rise will test those without real reserves. This race shape most favours horses that can sit just off the pace in the first three to five positions with cover, travel smoothly into contention, and produce a clean, sustained finish through the final furlong; true hold-up horses face a wall of bodies on a track where late gaps are hard to find in big-field sprints, giving the edge to organised, prominent-to-midfield professionals with strong Goodwood form.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Contested Pace, Prominent Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Sir Garfield leads at a genuine clip pressed by Expert Agent, Supreme King and Under The Twilight, setting a true test on Good ground.
scenarios.body: The pace is honest enough to string the field out but no single horse is allowed to coast in front, meaning those sitting second or third with cover have the ideal trip; Goodwood's final-furlong rise then filters out horses who have used energy fighting for position.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sir Garfield Controls, Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Sir Garfield is allowed to bowl along uncontested or near-uncontested with the big field creating a bunching effect that shields him from sustained pressure.
scenarios.body: In a 28-runner sprint the chaos behind a clean front-runner can be decisive — horses in midfield spend energy manoeuvring while Sir Garfield settles into a rhythm and the rise doesn't catch him.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Closers Find Late Gap
scenarios.trigger: If the pace burns particularly hot early and the field spreads across the track, leaving a narrow late seam for hold-up horses to thread through in the final 100 yards.
scenarios.body: Winchurch, Vingegaard and Rory Rocket are genuine hold-up types with good Goodwood form who benefit if front-rankers tie each other up; the challenge is finding clear daylight in a 28-runner field on a track that narrows late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse, Midfield Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If the volume of prominent types produces an unusually fast early gallop that causes a wholesale fade from the front, allowing midfield stalkers with class to pick up the pieces.
scenarios.body: Arduis Invicta and Cashbox both have ability and enough tactical flexibility to be in the right part of the field if the pace implodes; Silver Wraith and Kesta are longer-priced alternatives with relevant course distances in their favour.

races.paceDynamic: Defence Minister is the one confirmed front-runner and will set a controlled, sustainable gallop over Goodwood's 7f on Good turf — with Jamie Spencer aboard, expect a measured tempo rather than a scorching pace that burns off rivals. The field is overloaded with prominent types: Colombier, Bobby Bennu, Pellitory, Silver Ghost, Morte Point, The Fingal Raven, and Superposition will all press for forward positions, and true prominent racers Crimson Spirit, Zarathos, Divine Libra, Humam, Oliver Show, and Goldmoyne cannot all secure their natural berths — those most likely to actually front-up from that group are Crimson Spirit (Moore, aggressive) and Zarathos (Shoemark, has led before), but several will be shuffled back against their will. With one genuine front-runner dictating a sustainable pace and a convoy of prominent types grinding behind, the race will develop into a test of tactical efficiency rather than raw stamina, and hold-up horses who travel sweetly and find cover will arrive late with maximum momentum. This shape most favours horses racing from just off the pace in genuine midfield — those with proven Goodwood form, a clean turn of foot, and a rider capable of threading through a congested field in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Steady Pace, Closers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Defence Minister's controlled gallop keeps the tempo honest and the prominent convoy burns energy jostling for position, creating a true test of finishing speed.
scenarios.body: The sustainable early gallop means no one is cooked early, but the friction among the cluster of prominent types uses their energy, leaving the fluid hold-up runners with fresh legs entering the straight; Goodwood's downhill finish rewards those who quicken late rather than those who grind from the front.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate pace and Good ground allow the best-placed prominent runner to control their own destiny from a few lengths off Defence Minister without being pressured.
scenarios.body: A well-positioned prominent type who tracks Defence Minister comfortably, avoids the scrimmage, and kicks early on the descent can steal a decisive lead before hold-up horses fully wind up; Superposition and Silver Ghost both have the Goodwood course form and prominent style to execute this.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dictates
scenarios.trigger: If Spencer engineers a truly uncontested lead for Defence Minister and the field allows him to coast at a crawl, turning the race into a sprint for home.
scenarios.body: With no horse willing to genuinely challenge for the lead, Defence Minister controls every fraction and the finish becomes a dash from the front over the final two furlongs; this scenario suits Defence Minister's natural gate-to-wire profile when allowed total freedom, though its STYLE_FIT tag reflects that it is not always convincing in this role.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos In The Pack
scenarios.trigger: If the surplus of prominent types causes significant crowding and interference in the early to middle stages, forcing several out of rhythm and gifting the clearest passage to an outsider.
scenarios.body: A runner who accepts an untypically rearward position and finds an unobstructed route up the stand rail or middle of the track could emerge from the carnage with a clear run when rivals are still sorting positions; The Liffey's exceptional recent winning form and Goldmoyne's consistent Goodwood placed efforts could benefit from a clean passage.

watchPoints.text: Crimson Spirit and Zarathos are both natural prominent types crammed into a congested early group — Ryan Moore and Kieran Shoemark will compete hard for position in the first furlong, likely causing interference and uneven fractions for anything caught between them.

The Liffey's remarkable winning streak (four from five) arrives on unfamiliar Goodwood Good turf after all wins on Sandown Standard — watch whether Marco Ghiani can settle the horse if it meets resistance from the crowded hold-up group rather than finding its usual clean passage.

Defence Minister's pace control is the hinge of this entire race shape — if Jamie Spencer is pressured unexpectedly by Crimson Spirit or Zarathos muscling through, the tempo lifts sharply and the prominent convoy is cooked, dramatically enhancing the hold-up horses' prospects.
Superposition is the horse William Buick is most likely to place perfectly in the eye of the storm —
